title: C++: State Machine Library
description: Build a general-purpose state machine library with state transitions and callbacks.

steps.title: FSM Library
steps.description: Create a StateMachine template class templated on State enum. Support addTransition(from, event, to) and addOnEnter/onExit callbacks. Test with a simple traffic light: GREEN->YELLOW->RED->GREEN.
hints: void handle(Event e) { State next = transitions[{current, e}]; ... }
